title: A failed exercise swap or a failed past-workout start says 'try again' but leaves no record of why
what: In a live workout, when switching to the harder or easier version or swapping an exercise for today fails, the member sees 'Could not swap' or 'Could not switch, please try again'. Starting a past workout that fails shows 'Couldn't open the editor'. In all of these the real error is thrown away, so nothing is written to the phone's log.
expected: Every 'try again' message also writes the real error to the log, so a member's report can be traced.
how_often: each time a swap or past-workout start fails
fix_line: Log the real error before showing the try-again message

title: The rest alerts warning stays hidden, with no trace, when the phone's alert settings cannot be read
what: The row that warns rest alerts are blocked, silent or may be late starts as 'unknown' and only shows after a successful read. If the read fails, the failure is dropped silently, the row never appears, and the member is not told alerts may not ring. The same silent drop happens when a member's own exercise picture, the hidden-exercises count or the 'Last done' dates cannot be read.
expected: A failed read is written to the log, and the alerts row says it could not check rather than disappearing.
how_often: rare, when a phone setting read fails
fix_line: Log each failed read and show a could-not-check line for alerts

title: The month calendar is written three separate times, on two sets of calendar maths
what: Picking a workout or weigh-in day, picking the day of a past workout, and the month report each draw their own Monday-first month. Two use one set of calendar maths, the report uses another, and 'move one month' is written twice with the same name but different handling of a bad value. A fix to one calendar (for example which days can be picked) will not reach the others.
expected: One calendar part and one set of month maths shared by all three.
fix_line: Merge the three calendars into one shared part

title: Copies of locked shared parts are kept in step only by a few text checks, and the originals are no longer used
what: Because the shared sheet and charts are locked, the workout area keeps its own copies: a sheet with a Done tick, and two date-spaced charts. The sheet copy is kept in step with the original only by five phrases being present in both; its own note points to a test file that does not exist. No screen uses the original line chart or small trend line any more, yet both stay in the app.
expected: Either the shared parts are unlocked and extended, or the unused originals are removed and the copy has a real check.
how_often: at every change to the sheet or charts
fix_line: Remove the unused originals and point the note at the real check

title: No workout screen part in this group is ever run by a quick test; tests only look for words in its code
what: 39 of the 52 parts here (before-and-after share, weigh-in fix, hold timer, import, finish and others) are never loaded by any test. The tests that do mention parts here read the code as text and look for phrases, so they pass even if the part shows the wrong thing or crashes when opened.
expected: The parts that save or change a member's data are opened by a test and checked by what they show and do.
how_often: whenever one of these parts breaks
fix_line: Add render tests for the parts that save data, starting with weigh-in fix and finish

items.reason: only real-clock wait is a 30 ms pause after an awaited save; no orphan or flaky rows for this area
